section.div: Husband-approved enterprise™ homelab deployed with Talos Linux; managed with Flux, Renovate, and GitHub Actions 🤖
HELO: Test Big Ideas in Small Spaces.

Tubifarry is a Lidarr plugin that enhances your music library by fetching music from YouTube, integrating with Slskd for Soulseek access, automating Spotify playlist imports, converting files, and retrieving soundtracks from Radarr and Sonarr.
Agregarr is a Plex Collections manager that keeps your Home and Recommended fresh by frequently updating it with collections from various sources
The High-Availability Solution to a Problem That Doesn't Exist.
